assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production decorative sprite atlas for a Nintendo Switch football cup tournament interface. These are background images for a competition-wide news carousel, not a finished UI. TOP RIGHT: luminous deep teal stadium tunnel and abstract football field lines, a generic white football and subtle arena lights on the RIGHT THIRD, quiet dark teal left 60 percent. BOTTOM LEFT: rich crimson sports broadcast backdrop, diagonal fabric folds and a few restrained silver celebratory confetti accents on the right third; left 60 percent quiet deep burgundy. BOTTOM RIGHT: deep midnight blue with a warm gold stadium glow, a generic silver cup trophy silhouette and a few soft celebratory ribbons on the right third, left 60 percent quiet navy. Sophisticated modern Japanese football game art, refined photoreal materials, crisp at 720p, cohesive contrast and lighting, neutral to every team and suitable for local multiplayer competition. Text: NONE. No words, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, real-world trophies, teams, players, faces, controller graphics, UI components or watermark. Keep every artwork wholly within its quadrant. Exact straight grid boundaries at the image midpoints.
